10378|8b4f80e7.name: Omusa Thunderhorn
10378|8b4f80e7.text: Though the Crossroads seems to be the center of activity in The Barrens, I prefer the quietude of Camp Taurajo.  Where shall I send you?

11044|386a9ec7.name: Doctor Martin Felben
11044|386a9ec7.text: Once, it is true, I was human. What might otherwise be a shortcoming works to our advantage, $N, for I know human weaknesses intimately.

11833|eb2e4319.name: Rahauro
11833|eb2e4319.text:
Well met, $c. You may speak to me unless you have direct business with my mistress Magatha.

I deal with most of her tasks for her so she can concentrate on more important matters. Perhaps there are some things we could discuss before you seek audience with her?

11870|3a5c3d7e.name: Archibald
11870|3a5c3d7e.text: I suppose you are here to be trained in the use of a new weapon?  Make it fast, I'm very busy!

16227|c5ceacbe.name: Bragok
16227|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

1992|05f55f8a.name: Tarindrella
1992|05f55f8a.text: Only in Nature do we find purity.

2079|26ba7149.name: Conservator Ilthalaine
2079|26ba7149.text: Ah, the beauty of Shadowglen never ceases to delight my senses!

2082|7bfda406.name: Gilshalan Windwalker
2082|7bfda406.text: The flora and fauna of Shadowglen is a testament to our talents at working with nature.  It is an honor to bear witness to our grand achievement.

2425|7dca81fc.name: Varimathras
2425|7dca81fc.text:
Do not presume to speak to me as though you are my equal, $c. Sylvanas is my queen, and I will do as she bids.

If you do not show the proper respect, I assure you, we can find a more than suitable place for you in the Nether.

But there is no reason we cannot have words if you wish to aid the Dark Lady...

267333|0371bf6f.name: Terunne Bearshaper
267333|0371bf6f.text: Care to learn how to gather leather from slain beasts? Or do you need some new tools?

2995|bfaf54b7.name: Tal
2995|bfaf54b7.text: When mounted on the back of a wind rider, one sees that its reputation for strength and speed is well earned.

3216|e0c203bc.name: Neeru Fireblade
3216|e0c203bc.text: I will make it known to you. You are obviously already proving yourself in our ranks to become a lieutenant so quickly. Perhaps you can return to me later and I will have tasks for you. The council adores those skilled in the arcane, but servants of all kinds are always welcome, no matter their profession.

3310|cc0cf280.name: Doras
3310|cc0cf280.text: You haven't lived until you've looked down on the world from the back of a wind rider.

3391|8f749700.name: Gazlowe
3391|8f749700.text: Thrall paid me and my boys well for helping out with the construction of Orgrimmar, so I decided to set up a port here. We do most of our business through Booty Bay and Baron Revilgaz.

3430|0e16a4d2.name: Mangletooth
3430|0e16a4d2.text:
You! $R! Come here. <snort>

Time is short, and my end <snort> is near. Mangletooth shall win; you will see. <snort>

My capture can still aid <snort> my people. The Razormane tribe is more powerful than the Bristlebacks!

The Horde looks to find out who leads the raids on their people. You <snort> shall aid Mangletooth in return for the information only I know. Mangletooth can help you! <snort> But you must help Mangletooth.

3442|ef9d74c5.name: Sputtervalve
3442|ef9d74c5.text: Director Riddlevox put me in charge of the Union's shredder development program. Few months on the job and I'm already in hot water! I could use your help, $N!

3453|48c11c0f.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
3453|48c11c0f.text: Something I can help you with, $N? There's a shipment I've got to see to otherwise.

3489|68d65f37.name: Zargh
3489|68d65f37.text: Have a look at my meats, friend.  You won't want to go out into the Barrens without a good stock of provisions.

4551|d37b59d0.name: Michael Garrett
4551|d37b59d0.text: How may I be of service?

4949|9255c79c.name: Thrall
4949|9255c79c.text:
It would be wise to explain to you the depths at which our enemies will go to to hide themselves under our noses.

Know this first and foremost: our enemy is the Shadow Council. No matter what task I give you, or who I ask you to act against, know that one simple fact.

Many cults exist within the Council, but only to hide its actions against the foolish.

Groups like the Burning Blade, the Argus Wake, and the Searing Blade are all tools of the Council. Consider them one and the same.

6791|60c5da07.name: Innkeeper Wiley
6791|60c5da07.text: Come in, come in. Just don't sit too close to the stove. It hasn't exploded yet today, but just to be safe I think you should sit elsewhere.

7683|a4ef73af.name: Alessandro Luca
7683|a4ef73af.text: Welcome to Blue Moon Odds and Ends, $c.  If you have any questions, please let me know.

9564|8d6952f8.name: Frezza
9564|8d6952f8.text: Of course there's no danger in everything catching flames and exploding like a huge helium bomb. This baby will get you to Undercity faster and safer than any boat, and the view is truly breathtaking. Speaking of breath, smoking is not allowed while on board the zeppelin, and fire spells are banned from being cast during the trip.

3117-progress.name: Ayanna Everstride
3117-progress.text:
You've arrived, and none too soon, $N. Welcome to Shadowglen.

I trust my sigil found you in good spirits and health?

As I said previously, I am here to train you as a $c; to tame beasts to aid you in battle; to use a bow with unerring accuracy; to respect the lands which we call home and also the lands beyond.
3117-progress.title: Etched Sigil

3521-progress.name: Dirania Silvershine
3521-progress.text: Please, collect the ingredients, $N. Iverron needs our help.
3521-progress.title: Iverron's Antidote

3522-progress.name: Iverron
3522-progress.text: Oh... $N, I'm so glad you have returned.
3522-progress.title: Iverron's Antidote

459-progress.name: Tarindrella
459-progress.text: Satisfy my suspicions, $N.  Bring to me 8 Fel Moss.
459-progress.title: The Woodland Protector

916-progress.name: Gilshalan Windwalker
916-progress.text: Did you gather the venom sacs, $N?
916-progress.title: Webwood Venom

917-progress.name: Gilshalan Windwalker
917-progress.text: Have you been inside the Shadowthread Cave, $N?  Did you find a spider egg?
917-progress.title: Webwood Egg

97977-progress.name: Tarindrella
97977-progress.text: Don't worry about any larger totems you might find. I wouldn't know what to do with them if you found a way to get them!
97977-progress.title: Nature's Call

97979-accept.name: Shanda
97979-accept.text:
You are born kaldorei--the children of the stars--and have inherited a birthright unlike any other in this world. Elune's grace may illuminate our strengths, helping our strikes hit true, or it may help conceal us just as the moon may eclipse the sun.

Our Long Vigil after the defense of Mount Hyjal has ended, and we have joined an Alliance of others--which you will meet in due time. For now, you are nestled in the boughs of Teldrassil.

Demonstrate Mother Moon's gifts, and bask in her blessings.
97979-accept.title: The Goddess Provides
